rules.summary: Core data model and error contract guard: Zero-panic Result propagation and immutable OID hashing semantics
Git object model serialization guard: Strict standard loose/pack object header format and SHA-1/SHA-256 dual compatibility
Lockless in-memory git index concurrency guard: Conflict stage resolution and lock-free slot allocation
Myers diff, 3-way merge, and FastCDC chunking algorithm boundary and determinism guard
Resource recycling pool bounded governor: Zero unbounded transient memory allocations and lifecycle reclamation
Storage layer crash safety: Append-only WAL journal consistency, loose ODB integrity, and CAS block deduplication
DAG topology traversal guard: Cycle detection, ancestor generation indexing, and branch divergence safety
Smart HTTP transport and packet-line streaming framing protocol compliance guard
Fractal Git domain gate guard: AST complexity constraints (CC <= 15), non-blocking I/O, and platform portability
LayerVFS CAS snapshot materializer bridge: Fixed-time O(1) page cache mapping and atomic tree commit
Micro-crate DAG single-direction dependency guard: Zero circular dependency and strict L1->L2->L3 layer isolation
Zero transient heap allocation guard in hot loops: Prohibit string/vec/clone allocation in critical paths (ADV-PRF-002)
Lock-free in-memory index concurrency guard: Prohibit blocking standard Mutex in virtual staging tree
Documented unsafe block safety proof guard: Prohibit bare undocumented unsafe blocks in Rust crates
Zero unwrap and expect panic guard: Enforce strong-typed Result propagation across production crates
Facade substantial burden and immutable freeze guard: Enforce ARCH-FAC-001 with ELOC budget and Object.freeze
Pre-review zone gate bridge verification guard: Strict rule catalog closure and sub-10ms AST slice check
